categories.label: granted
categories.meaning: Final clearance given: EC, CRZ, Stage-II / final diversion order, approval granted.

categories.label: ToR granted
categories.meaning: Terms of Reference issued. Scoping is done, but the EC itself is still to come.

categories.label: pending
categories.meaning: Still moving through the process, including drafts and proposals waiting on the applicant.

categories.label: rejected
categories.meaning: Rejected or revoked by the authority.

categories.label: withdrawn
categories.meaning: Closed without a decision: withdrawn by the applicant or sent back.

categories.label: delisted
categories.meaning: Removed from the portal by the system, usually because the application was left incomplete. Not counted as an application.

rules.re: ^pending.*(compens|complian|levies|stage-ii|diversion|approval letter|final approval|demand|union minister|director general)|^stage-i fc awaited
^(ec granted|granted|approval granted|approved|crz granted|stage-ii accorded|final diversion order issued|ec form 9 (approved|accepted))$
